First pass第一次读这一章

One sentence. FastICA repeatedly proposes a better projection direction and restores its length, using non-Gaussian structure that whitening leaves unresolved.

一句话直觉。FastICA 反复提出一个更合适的投影方向，再把长度归一化；它利用的是白化之后仍然留下的非高斯结构。

By the end, you should be able to:

读完后，你应能：

  • calculate one cubic update and its normalization;
  • explain why opposite signs can represent the same recovered component;
  • identify a zero or rank-deficient update instead of silently normalizing it.
  • 算出一次三次非线性更新，并完成归一化；
  • 解释为什么相反符号可以表示同一个恢复成分；
  • 识别零更新或秩亏更新，而不是不加检查地归一化。

Route. Review the whitened model and kurtosis of a mixture. Read the update rule, multiple components and diagnostics. First understand the iteration; the approximate-Newton derivation and convergence proof can follow later. The code guide explains how to reproduce the example.

路线。先复习白化后的模型与混合的峭度。先读更新规则、多个成分及诊断。先理解迭代操作，近似牛顿法推导和收敛证明可以稍后读。代码指南说明怎样复现实例。

Quick check 1. If a new iterate is exactly −w-\bw−w, is it a different component?

自测 1。若新迭代恰好等于 −w-\bw−w，它是不是另一个成分？

Check the answer查看答案

No. Its output is only the sign-reversed version of the old output. ICA cannot identify source signs, so the stopping comparison must allow this equivalence.

不是。它的输出只是原输出反号。ICA 无法辨识源的符号，所以停止比较必须允许这种等价性。

Quick check 2. If both kurtoses are zero, can this cubic update be normalized? Does that prove both sources Gaussian?

自测 2。若两个峭度都为零，这个三次更新能否归一化？是否由此证明两个源都高斯？

Check the answer查看答案

The raw population update is zero, so normalization is undefined. Zero kurtosis does not prove Gaussianity; a different contrast may detect non-Gaussian structure missed by this one.

总体原始更新为零，无法定义归一化。零峭度不能证明高斯性；其他对比函数可能察觉这个对比函数漏掉的非高斯结构。

8.1 A fixed-point view不动点的视角

The gradient algorithms of Chapter 7第 7 章 need a step size, and near a solution they converge only linearly, at a rate set by the smallest eigenvalue of their linearization. FastICA (Hyvärinen & Oja, 1997; Hyvärinen, 1999) takes another route. It works on whitened data, estimates one direction at a time on the unit sphere, and replaces the gradient step by a fixed-point iteration obtained from Newton's method. The result has no step size, has local quadratic or even cubic convergence in the population model, and can need only a few iterations on well-conditioned examples. This is not a global or finite-sample iteration guarantee. This chapter derives the iteration, proves its convergence in source coordinates, builds the versions that estimate several components, and discusses the choice of nonlinearity.

Chapter 7第 7 章中的梯度算法需要选择步长，而且在解附近只是线性收敛，收敛速度由线性化的最小特征值决定。FastICA（Hyvärinen & Oja, 1997; Hyvärinen, 1999）走的是另一条路：它在白化数据上工作，在单位球面上一次估计一个方向，并用由牛顿法导出的不动点迭代代替梯度步。这样得到的算法没有步长，在总体模型下局部二次甚至三次收敛，在条件良好的例子中只需少数几次迭代；这不是全局或有限样本的迭代次数保证。本章推导这一迭代，在源坐标下证明其收敛性，构造同时估计多个成分的版本，并讨论非线性函数的选择。

The setting is that of Chapter 3第 3 章: the data are whitened, z=Vx=A~s\bz = \bV\bx = \tilde\bA\bsz=Vx=A~s with A~\tilde\bAA~ orthogonal (Proposition 3.4命题 3.4), and the sources have zero mean and unit variance. A one-unit method looks for a unit vector w\bww such that y=w⊤zy = \bw^\top\bzy=w⊤z is one of the sources. In source coordinates, q=A~⊤w\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w is again a unit vector and y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s; the direction w\bww recovers source iii exactly when q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​, where ei\be_iei​ is the iii-th standard basis vector.

问题的设定与Chapter 3第 3 章相同：数据已经白化，z=Vx=A~s\bz = \bV\bx = \tilde\bA\bsz=Vx=A~s，其中 A~\tilde\bAA~ 是正交矩阵（Proposition 3.4命题 3.4），源均值为零、方差为一。单单元方法寻找一个单位向量 w\bww，使 y=w⊤zy = \bw^\top\bzy=w⊤z 恰好是某一个源。在源坐标下，q=A~⊤w\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w 仍是单位向量，且 y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s；方向 w\bww 恢复出源 iii，当且仅当 q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​，这里 ei\be_iei​ 是第 iii 个标准基向量。

Proposition 8.1 (critical points of the one-unit contrast)命题 8.1（单单元对比函数的临界点）

Let GGG be even and twice continuously differentiable, and let the sources be independent with zero mean, unit variance and finite moments of the orders needed below. On the unit sphere, f(q)=E G(q⊤s)f(\bq) = \E\,G(\bq^\top\bs)f(q)=EG(q⊤s) has a critical point at every ±ei\pm\be_i±ei​. It is a strict local maximum if λi>0\lambda_i > 0λi​>0 and a strict local minimum if λi<0\lambda_i < 0λi​<0 (Hyvärinen, 1999).

设 GGG 为二阶连续可微的偶函数，各源相互独立、均值为零、方差为一，且下面用到的各阶矩有限。在单位球面上，f(q)=E G(q⊤s)f(\bq) = \E\,G(\bq^\top\bs)f(q)=EG(q⊤s) 在每个 ±ei\pm\be_i±ei​ 处取临界点。若 λi>0\lambda_i > 0λi​>0，它是严格局部极大值点；若 λi<0\lambda_i < 0λi​<0，它是严格局部极小值点（Hyvärinen, 1999）。

Three consequences are worth stating. First, the iteration converges to source directions whether they are maxima or minima of E G\E\,GEG: only λi≠0\lambda_i \ne 0λi​=0 matters, so FastICA finds sub- and super-Gaussian sources with the same nonlinearity. When λi<0\lambda_i < 0λi​<0 the vector flips sign at every step, which is why convergence is tested through ∣w+⊤w∣|\bw^{+\top}\bw|∣w+⊤w∣. Second, part (a) is a global statement: for a random start, ties in ∣κi∣ ∣qi(0)∣\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|∣κi​∣​∣qi(0)​∣ have probability zero, so the kurtosis iteration converges from almost every starting point. Part (b) is local. Third, a Gaussian source has λi=0\lambda_i = 0λi​=0 (Stein's lemma) and is never a fixed point; with kurtosis its coordinate is set to zero in one step (Exercise 8.2习题 8.2).

有三点推论值得一提。第一，无论源方向是 E G\E\,GEG 的极大值点还是极小值点，迭代都会收敛到它：要紧的只是 λi≠0\lambda_i \ne 0λi​=0，所以 FastICA 用同一个非线性函数就能找到亚高斯源和超高斯源。当 λi<0\lambda_i < 0λi​<0 时，向量每一步都改变符号，这就是要用 ∣w+⊤w∣|\bw^{+\top}\bw|∣w+⊤w∣ 来检验收敛的原因。第二，（a）是全局性的结论：随机初始化时，∣κi∣ ∣qi(0)∣\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|∣κi​∣​∣qi(0)​∣ 出现并列的概率为零，所以峭度迭代几乎从任何起点出发都收敛。（b）则是局部结论。第三，高斯源满足 λi=0\lambda_i = 0λi​=0（Stein 引理），永远不是不动点；用峭度时，它对应的坐标一步之内就被置为零（Exercise 8.2习题 8.2）。

With a finite sample the iteration uses E^\hat\EE^ and converges to a fixed point of the sample map, which lies within O(T−1/2)O(T^{-1/2})O(T−1/2) of the population fixed point; its accuracy is the subject of Theorem 10.8定理 10.8. At that point the derivative of the sample map is no longer exactly zero but of the order of the sampling error. In our experiments with g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh and TTT from 10310^3103 to 10610^6106 its norm was of the order of 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​, typically a few times 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​, with a factor that depended on the sources and on the sample. The final iterations therefore converge linearly, but with a ratio so small that this is rarely visible. In the run of Figure 8.1图 8.1(b), with T=104T = 10^4T=104, the measure drops by a factor of about 600 per iteration at the end, so the angle between successive iterates shrinks by a factor of about 25, a contraction of about 4/T4/\sqrt{T}4/T​.

在有限样本下，迭代使用 E^\hat\EE^，收敛到样本映射的不动点，它与总体不动点相距 O(T−1/2)O(T^{-1/2})O(T−1/2)；其精度是Theorem 10.8定理 10.8的主题。在这个点上，样本映射的导数不再恰好为零，而是与抽样误差同阶。在我们用 g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh 做的实验中，对 TTT 从 10310^3103 到 10610^6106，该导数的范数都是 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​ 量级，通常是 1/T1/\sqrt{T}1/T​ 的几倍，倍数随源和样本而变。因此最后几次迭代是线性收敛的，但收敛比小到几乎看不出来。在Figure 8.1图 8.1（b）的运行中（T=104T = 10^4T=104），最后阶段度量值每次迭代约缩小为原来的 1/600，于是相邻迭代之间的夹角每次约缩小为原来的 1/25，即收缩比约为 4/T4/\sqrt{T}4/T​。

8.5 Estimating several components估计多个成分

From one component to several. Repeating a good one-unit search can repeatedly find the same source. Deflation excludes directions already found; symmetric orthogonalization adjusts all rows together. Orthogonality prevents duplication in the whitened geometry, but by itself does not certify statistical independence.

从一个成分到多个成分。重复一次有效的单成分搜索，可能反复找到同一个源。逐个提取会排除已找到的方向；对称正交化则同时调整所有行。白化坐标中的正交性可以避免方向重复，但它本身不证明统计独立。

Running the one-unit algorithm nnn times from random starts would often find the same source several times. Since the columns of A~\tilde\bAA~ are orthonormal, the rows wi⊤\bw_i^\topwi⊤​ of the orthogonal unmixing matrix U\bUU must be orthonormal too, and FastICA enforces this in one of two ways. In this section, as in the FastICA literature, W\bWW denotes the matrix with rows wi⊤\bw_i^\topwi⊤​, which acts on whitened data and is the orthogonal matrix U\bUU of Table 1.1表 1.1; the unmixing matrix for x\bxx is WV\bW\bVWV.

从随机起点把单单元算法独立运行 nnn 次，往往会多次找到同一个源。由于 A~\tilde\bAA~ 的列是标准正交的，正交解混矩阵 U\bUU 的各行 wi⊤\bw_i^\topwi⊤​ 也必须标准正交，FastICA 用以下两种方式之一来保证这一点。本节沿用 FastICA 文献的习惯，用 W\bWW 表示以 wi⊤\bw_i^\topwi⊤​ 为行、作用于白化数据的矩阵，即Table 1.1表 1.1中的正交矩阵 U\bUU；对 x\bxx 的解混矩阵是 WV\bW\bVWV。

Deflation. Estimate the vectors one after another. While iterating for wp\bw_pwp​, follow each update by a Gram–Schmidt step against the vectors already found, wp←wp−∑j<p(wp⊤wj) wj\bw_p \leftarrow \bw_p - \sum_{j < p}(\bw_p^\top\bw_j)\,\bw_jwp​←wp​−∑j<p​(wp⊤​wj​)wj​, and then normalize. If w1,…,wp−1\bw_1, \dots, \bw_{p-1}w1​,…,wp−1​ were exact source directions, the remaining sources would span exactly the orthogonal complement, and the iteration there is again a one-unit problem with fewer sources, so Theorem 8.3定理 8.3 applies. With estimated vectors, however, each error tilts the subspace in which all later vectors must lie, so errors accumulate along the sequence; the last vector has no freedom left at all, being the unit vector orthogonal to the others. The order in which sources come out depends on the starting points and the contrast, not on any property chosen by the user.

逐个提取（紧缩）。依次估计各个向量。在迭代求 wp\bw_pwp​ 时，每次更新之后都对已经求得的向量做一次 Gram–Schmidt 正交化，wp←wp−∑j<p(wp⊤wj) wj\bw_p \leftarrow \bw_p - \sum_{j < p}(\bw_p^\top\bw_j)\,\bw_jwp​←wp​−∑j<p​(wp⊤​wj​)wj​，然后归一化。如果 w1,…,wp−1\bw_1, \dots, \bw_{p-1}w1​,…,wp−1​ 恰好是源方向，其余的源正好张成其正交补空间，在这个子空间里的迭代又是一个源更少的单单元问题，于是Theorem 8.3定理 8.3适用。但对估计得到的向量，每个误差都会使后续向量所在的子空间发生倾斜，误差沿着序列不断累积；最后一个向量则完全没有自由度，只能是与其他向量都正交的那个单位向量。源被提取出来的顺序取决于起点和对比函数，而不是由用户指定的某种性质。

Symmetric orthogonalization. Update all nnn vectors in parallel with (8.3), stack them as the rows of W\bWW, and replace W\bWW by the orthogonal matrix

对称正交化。用 (8.3) 并行地更新全部 nnn 个向量，把它们作为 W\bWW 的各行，再把 W\bWW 替换为正交矩阵

W←(WW⊤)−1/2 W.(8.5)\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\,\bW.\tag{8.5}W←(WW⊤)−1/2W.(8.5)

Proposition 8.5 (symmetric orthogonalization)命题 8.5（对称正交化）

Let W\bWW be invertible with singular value decomposition W=LΣR⊤\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\topW=LΣR⊤. Then (WW⊤)−1/2W=LR⊤(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top(WW⊤)−1/2W=LR⊤. This matrix is orthogonal, it is the orthogonal matrix closest to W\bWW in Frobenius norm (the polar factor of W\bWW; Section A.4第 A.4 节, Proposition A.4命题 A.4), and it treats all rows alike: for every permutation matrix Π\bPiΠ, the result for ΠW\bPi\bWΠW is Π\bPiΠ times the result for W\bWW.

设 W\bWW 可逆，其奇异值分解为 W=LΣR⊤\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\topW=LΣR⊤。则 (WW⊤)−1/2W=LR⊤(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top(WW⊤)−1/2W=LR⊤。这个矩阵是正交的，是在 Frobenius 范数下离 W\bWW 最近的正交矩阵（即 W\bWW 的极分解因子；见Section A.4第 A.4 节与Proposition A.4命题 A.4），并且对各行一视同仁：对任意置换矩阵 Π\bPiΠ，ΠW\bPi\bWΠW 的结果等于 Π\bPiΠ 乘以 W\bWW 的结果。

Proof.证明

WW⊤=LΣ2L⊤\bW\bW^\top = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^2\mathbf{L}^\topWW⊤=LΣ2L⊤, so (WW⊤)−1/2=LΣ−1L⊤(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2} = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top(WW⊤)−1/2=LΣ−1L⊤ and (WW⊤)−1/2W=LΣ−1L⊤LΣR⊤=LR⊤(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top(WW⊤)−1/2W=LΣ−1L⊤LΣR⊤=LR⊤, a product of orthogonal matrices. For the last claim, (ΠWW⊤Π⊤)−1/2=Π(WW⊤)−1/2Π⊤(\bPi\bW\bW^\top\bPi^\top)^{-1/2} = \bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bPi^\top(ΠWW⊤Π⊤)−1/2=Π(WW⊤)−1/2Π⊤, since ΠM−1/2Π⊤\bPi\bM^{-1/2}\bPi^\topΠM−1/2Π⊤ is a symmetric positive definite square root of (ΠMΠ⊤)−1(\bPi\bM\bPi^\top)^{-1}(ΠMΠ⊤)−1; multiplying by ΠW\bPi\bWΠW gives Π(WW⊤)−1/2W\bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bWΠ(WW⊤)−1/2W.

WW⊤=LΣ2L⊤\bW\bW^\top = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^2\mathbf{L}^\topWW⊤=LΣ2L⊤，所以 (WW⊤)−1/2=LΣ−1L⊤(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2} = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top(WW⊤)−1/2=LΣ−1L⊤，从而 (WW⊤)−1/2W=LΣ−1L⊤LΣR⊤=LR⊤(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top(WW⊤)−1/2W=LΣ−1L⊤LΣR⊤=LR⊤，它是正交矩阵的乘积。对最后一个结论，由于 ΠM−1/2Π⊤\bPi\bM^{-1/2}\bPi^\topΠM−1/2Π⊤ 是 (ΠMΠ⊤)−1(\bPi\bM\bPi^\top)^{-1}(ΠMΠ⊤)−1 的对称正定平方根，有 (ΠWW⊤Π⊤)−1/2=Π(WW⊤)−1/2Π⊤(\bPi\bW\bW^\top\bPi^\top)^{-1/2} = \bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bPi^\top(ΠWW⊤Π⊤)−1/2=Π(WW⊤)−1/2Π⊤；再乘以 ΠW\bPi\bWΠW 即得 Π(WW⊤)−1/2W\bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bWΠ(WW⊤)−1/2W。

Gram–Schmidt, by contrast, depends on the order of the rows (Exercise 8.3习题 8.3). The symmetric version estimates all components at once, so errors are not passed along a sequence, and the cost per iteration is that of nnn one-unit updates plus one n×nn \times nn×n eigendecomposition. If an inverse square root is undesirable, the iteration W←32W−12WW⊤W\bW \leftarrow \tfrac32\bW - \tfrac12\bW\bW^\top\bWW←23​W−21​WW⊤W (Hyvärinen, 1999), started after dividing W\bWW by ∥W∥F\|\bW\|_F∥W∥F​, converges quadratically to the same matrix (Exercise 8.4习题 8.4).

与之相比，Gram–Schmidt 正交化的结果依赖于各行的顺序（Exercise 8.3习题 8.3）。对称版本同时估计所有成分，误差不会沿着一个序列向后传递，每次迭代的代价是 nnn 次单单元更新再加一次 n×nn \times nn×n 的特征分解。如果不想计算逆平方根，可以先把 W\bWW 除以 ∥W∥F\|\bW\|_F∥W∥F​，再迭代 W←32W−12WW⊤W\bW \leftarrow \tfrac32\bW - \tfrac12\bW\bW^\top\bWW←23​W−21​WW⊤W（Hyvärinen, 1999），它二次收敛到同一个矩阵（Exercise 8.4习题 8.4）。

Algorithm 8.6 (symmetric FastICA)算法 8.6（对称 FastICA）

  1. Center and whiten the data, z(t)=Vx(t)\bz(t) = \bV\bx(t)z(t)=Vx(t).
  2. Choose GGG and a random n×nn \times nn×n matrix W\bWW; orthogonalize it with (8.5).
  3. For every row, wi+=E^[z g(wi⊤z)]−E^[g′(wi⊤z)] wi\bw_i^+ = \hat\E[\bz\,g(\bw_i^\top\bz)] - \hat\E[g'(\bw_i^\top\bz)]\,\bw_iwi+​=E^[zg(wi⊤​z)]−E^[g′(wi⊤​z)]wi​; let W+\bW^+W+ have rows wi+⊤\bw_i^{+\top}wi+⊤​.
  4. Set Wnew=(W+W+⊤)−1/2W+\bW_{\text{new}} = (\bW^+\bW^{+\top})^{-1/2}\bW^+Wnew​=(W+W+⊤)−1/2W+.
  5. If 1−min⁡i∣wi,new⊤wi∣1 - \min_i|\bw_{i,\text{new}}^\top\bw_i|1−mini​∣wi,new⊤​wi​∣ is below a tolerance, stop with W=Wnew\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}W=Wnew​; otherwise set W=Wnew\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}W=Wnew​ and return to step 3.
  6. Output the estimated sources y(t)=Wz(t)\by(t) = \bW\bz(t)y(t)=Wz(t) and the unmixing matrix WV\bW\bVWV.
  1. 中心化并白化数据，z(t)=Vx(t)\bz(t) = \bV\bx(t)z(t)=Vx(t)。
  2. 选取 GGG 和一个随机的 n×nn \times nn×n 矩阵 W\bWW，并用 (8.5) 把它正交化。
  3. 对每一行计算 wi+=E^[z g(wi⊤z)]−E^[g′(wi⊤z)] wi\bw_i^+ = \hat\E[\bz\,g(\bw_i^\top\bz)] - \hat\E[g'(\bw_i^\top\bz)]\,\bw_iwi+​=E^[zg(wi⊤​z)]−E^[g′(wi⊤​z)]wi​；令 W+\bW^+W+ 的各行为 wi+⊤\bw_i^{+\top}wi+⊤​。
  4. 令 Wnew=(W+W+⊤)−1/2W+\bW_{\text{new}} = (\bW^+\bW^{+\top})^{-1/2}\bW^+Wnew​=(W+W+⊤)−1/2W+。
  5. 若 1−min⁡i∣wi,new⊤wi∣1 - \min_i|\bw_{i,\text{new}}^\top\bw_i|1−mini​∣wi,new⊤​wi​∣ 小于容差则以 W=Wnew\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}W=Wnew​ 停止；否则令 W=Wnew\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}W=Wnew​，回到第 3 步。
  6. 输出估计的源 y(t)=Wz(t)\by(t) = \bW\bz(t)y(t)=Wz(t) 以及解混矩阵 WV\bW\bVWV。

The script below is a complete implementation, applied to four sources of different types: uniform, Laplace, binary ±1\pm1±1 and Student-ttt with 5 degrees of freedom, all with unit variance.

下面的脚本是一个完整的实现，用于四个不同类型的源：均匀分布、拉普拉斯分布、取值 ±1\pm1±1 的二值分布，以及自由度为 5 的 Student-ttt 分布，全部为单位方差。

import numpy as np

def whiten(X):
    """Rows are channels; use covariance / T, matching all sample expectations."""
    X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)
    if X.ndim != 2 or not np.isfinite(X).all():
        raise ValueError("X must be a finite channels-by-samples matrix")
    n, T = X.shape
    if n < 1 or T <= n:
        raise ValueError("Need more samples than channels; reduce rank first")
    mean = X.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    Xc = X - mean
    E, d, _ = np.linalg.svd(Xc / np.sqrt(T), full_matrices=False)
    if d[-1] <= 1e-12 * d[0]:
        raise ValueError("Rank-deficient data: select a signal subspace first")
    V = (E / d) @ E.T
    return V @ Xc, V, mean

def sym_orth(W):
    """Polar factor by SVD, avoiding squaring the condition number."""
    if not np.isfinite(W).all():
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite FastICA update")
    L, d, Rt = np.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
    if d[-1] <= 1e-12 * d[0]:
        raise ValueError("Degenerate update: change contrast or handle Gaussian residual")
    return L @ Rt

def fastica_symmetric(X, g, dg, max_iter=100, tol=1e-12, seed=0):
    Z, V, mean = whiten(X)
    n, T = Z.shape
    W = sym_orth(np.random.default_rng(seed).standard_normal((n, n)))
    for it in range(1, max_iter + 1):
        Y = W @ Z
        W_new = sym_orth(g(Y) @ Z.T / T - dg(Y).mean(axis=1)[:, None] * W)
        change = np.clip(1 - np.min(np.abs(np.sum(W_new * W, axis=1))), 0, 1)
        W = W_new
        print(f"iteration {it}: 1 - min|<w_new, w_old>| = {change:.1e}")
        if change < tol:
            return W @ V, mean
    raise RuntimeError("FastICA did not converge; inspect rank, contrast and starts")

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
T = 10000
S = np.vstack([rng.uniform(-np.sqrt(3), np.sqrt(3), T),
               rng.laplace(0, 1 / np.sqrt(2), T),
               np.sign(rng.standard_normal(T)),
               rng.standard_t(5, T) / np.sqrt(5 / 3)])
A = rng.standard_normal((4, 4))
X = A @ S
W, mean = fastica_symmetric(X, np.tanh, lambda y: 1 - np.tanh(y) ** 2)
Y = W @ (X - mean)                          # apply the fitted centering as well
P = W @ A
print(np.round(P / np.abs(P).max(axis=1, keepdims=True), 2) + 0.0)

它的输出为

iteration 2: 1 - min|<w_new, w_old>| = 1.7e-01
iteration 3: 1 - min|<w_new, w_old>| = 3.1e-03
iteration 4: 1 - min|<w_new, w_old>| = 5.3e-06
iteration 5: 1 - min|<w_new, w_old>| = 8.6e-09
iteration 6: 1 - min|<w_new, w_old>| = 1.4e-11
iteration 7: 1 - min|<w_new, w_old>| = 2.3e-14
[[ 0.    0.    1.    0.01]

Seven iterations suffice, and the global matrix, with each row scaled by its largest entry, is a signed permutation up to off-diagonal entries of about 0.01–0.02, the estimation error for T=10000T = 10000T=10000. The same nonlinearity tanh⁡\tanhtanh has found the sub-Gaussian uniform and binary sources as well as the two super-Gaussian ones. Figure 8.1图 8.1(b) shows that the other two nonlinearities converge just as fast on these data. The convergence of symmetric FastICA, in which the units are coupled through the orthogonalization, has been analysed by Oja and Yuan (2006). In a population check with exact expectations and the kurtosis nonlinearity, the distance to the nearest signed permutation fell from 0.100.100.10 to 2.6×10−42.6 \times 10^{-4}2.6×10−4 to 4.3×10−124.3 \times 10^{-12}4.3×10−12, again a cubic pattern.

七次迭代就足够了。把全局矩阵的每一行除以该行绝对值最大的元素后，它是一个带符号的置换矩阵，非对角元只有约 0.01–0.02，这是 T=10000T = 10000T=10000 时的估计误差。同一个非线性函数 tanh⁡\tanhtanh 既找到了亚高斯的均匀源和二值源，也找到了两个超高斯源。Figure 8.1图 8.1（b）表明，另两种非线性函数在这组数据上收敛得同样快。对称 FastICA 中各单元通过正交化相互耦合，其收敛性已由 Oja 与 Yuan（2006）分析过。在一个用精确期望、取峭度非线性的总体检验中，到最近的带符号置换矩阵的距离从 0.100.100.10 降到 2.6×10−42.6 \times 10^{-4}2.6×10−4，再降到 4.3×10−124.3 \times 10^{-12}4.3×10−12，同样呈现三次收敛的模式。

8.6 Choosing the nonlinearity非线性函数的选择

Robustness. Each observation enters through z g(w⊤z)\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)zg(w⊤z). The cubic ggg amplifies large projections; bounded ggg, such as tanh⁡\tanhtanh or ue−u2/2u e^{-u^2/2}ue−u2/2, reduces that amplification. It does not bound the whole vector contribution: an observation can have a moderate projection but arbitrarily large coordinates orthogonal to w\bww. Moreover, ordinary sample-mean centering and covariance whitening are themselves sensitive to outliers. Hyvärinen (1999, Theorem 3) explicitly assumes robust whitening and obtains a restricted influence bound, not a globally bounded influence function. Diagnose contamination in the full observation space and in preprocessing; changing ggg alone does not make the complete pipeline robust.

稳健性。每个观测通过 z g(w⊤z)\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)zg(w⊤z) 进入更新。三次函数 ggg 会放大大的投影值；tanh⁡\tanhtanh 或 ue−u2/2u e^{-u^2/2}ue−u2/2 这样的有界 ggg 可以减弱这种放大，但不能限制整个向量的贡献：一个观测的投影可以适中，而与 w\bww 正交的坐标任意大。此外，普通样本均值中心化和协方差白化本身也对离群值敏感。Hyvärinen（1999）的定理 3 明确假定采用稳健白化，并只给出受限的影响界，而不是全局有界的影响函数。因此应在完整观测空间和预处理中诊断污染；只替换 ggg 并不能使整条分析流程都稳健。

Accuracy. The asymptotic variance of the one-unit estimator (Theorem 10.8定理 10.8) has λi2=(E[si g(si)−g′(si)])2\lambda_i^2 = (\E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)])^2λi2​=(E[si​g(si​)−g′(si​)])2 in its denominator. A source with λi\lambda_iλi​ close to zero for the chosen ggg is estimated poorly and, with finite data, found slowly or not at all; a non-Gaussian source can even have λi=0\lambda_i = 0λi​=0 for one particular ggg (a source with zero kurtosis is invisible to g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3), and then another ggg must be used. The variance is smallest when ggg is a linear combination of the source score and the identity function (with an arbitrary added constant if sample centering is used) (Proposition 10.9命题 10.9). Since one fixed ggg cannot be optimal for sources of different types, the EFICA algorithm of Koldovský, Tichavský and Oja (2006) adapts the nonlinearity to each component after a symmetric FastICA run; Chapter 10第 10 章 returns to it.

精度。单单元估计量的渐近方差（Theorem 10.8定理 10.8）的分母中含有 λi2=(E[si g(si)−g′(si)])2\lambda_i^2 = (\E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)])^2λi2​=(E[si​g(si​)−g′(si​)])2。对所选的 ggg，若某个源的 λi\lambda_iλi​ 接近零，它的估计就很差，在有限数据下找到它也很慢，甚至找不到；一个非高斯源对某个特定的 ggg 甚至可能恰好有 λi=0\lambda_i = 0λi​=0（峭度为零的源对 g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3 不可见），这时必须换用别的 ggg。当 ggg 是源得分函数与恒等函数的线性组合时（采用样本中心化时还可加任意常数），方差最小（Proposition 10.9命题 10.9）。由于一个固定的 ggg 不可能对不同类型的源都最优，Koldovský、Tichavský 与 Oja（2006）的 EFICA 算法在对称 FastICA 运行之后为每个成分自适应地选择非线性函数；Chapter 10第 10 章会再回到这一点。

Speed. Kurtosis gives cubic convergence for any sources, the other two nonlinearities give cubic convergence for symmetric sources and quadratic convergence otherwise. In practice the difference amounts to at most an iteration or two (Figure 8.1图 8.1). Each iteration costs one pass over the data, of order nTnTnT operations per unit; evaluating tanh⁡\tanhtanh or an exponential is slower than a cube, but rarely enough to matter.

速度。峭度对任何源都给出三次收敛；另两种非线性函数对对称源三次收敛，否则二次收敛。实践中两者的差别至多一两次迭代（Figure 8.1图 8.1）。每次迭代需要遍历一次数据，每个单元的计算量为 nTnTnT 量级；计算 tanh⁡\tanhtanh 或指数函数比计算立方慢，但很少慢到值得在意的程度。

These considerations lead to the usual practice, recommended by Hyvärinen (1999): log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh with a=1a = 1a=1 as the default; the Gaussian-shaped GGG when the sources are strongly super-Gaussian or the data contain outliers; kurtosis mainly for sub-Gaussian sources in clean data, where its fourth-moment estimates are stable. Whatever the choice, the sign of λi\lambda_iλi​ need not be known in advance.

由这些考虑得到通常的做法，这也是 Hyvärinen（1999）的建议：默认使用 a=1a = 1a=1 的 log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh；当源是强超高斯的或数据含有离群点时，使用高斯形的 GGG；峭度主要用于不含离群点的数据中的亚高斯源，此时四阶矩的估计是稳定的。无论选哪一种，都无须事先知道 λi\lambda_iλi​ 的符号。

8.7 Rank, convergence and reproducible use秩、收敛诊断与可复现使用

Use one covariance convention. All sample expectations in the fixed-point update use 1/T1/T1/T. Whitening with C^=XcXc⊤/T\hat\bC=\bX_c\bX_c^\top/TC^=Xc​Xc⊤​/T therefore gives ZZ⊤/T=I\bZ\bZ^\top/T=\bIZZ⊤/T=I exactly up to round-off. NumPy's default np.cov uses 1/(T−1)1/(T-1)1/(T−1), which instead gives (T−1)I/T(T-1)\bI/T(T−1)I/T under the later averaging convention. The difference is small for large TTT, but the implementation should match its own derivation. The SVD above also avoids forming a covariance matrix whose condition number is the square of that of the centered data.

统一协方差约定。不动点更新中的样本期望全部使用 1/T1/T1/T，所以应以 C^=XcXc⊤/T\hat\bC=\bX_c\bX_c^\top/TC^=Xc​Xc⊤​/T 白化，使 ZZ⊤/T=I\bZ\bZ^\top/T=\bIZZ⊤/T=I 在舍入误差以内成立。NumPy 默认的 np.cov 使用 1/(T−1)1/(T-1)1/(T−1)，按后续平均约定得到的会是 (T−1)I/T(T-1)\bI/T(T−1)I/T。大样本时差别虽小，实现仍应与推导一致。上面的 SVD 也避免了显式形成协方差矩阵；后者的条件数是中心化数据矩阵条件数的平方。

Do not hide rank failure. Repeated channels, constant channels, or retaining more dimensions than the centered data rank make whitening impossible. Reduce to a justified signal subspace; replacing every tiny eigenvalue by an arbitrary constant changes the model and can amplify noise. A zero one-unit update cannot be normalized. A rank-deficient simultaneous update has no unique invertible polar factor. In particular, an exactly Gaussian population component has a zero update; recover the identifiable non-Gaussian components and explicitly complete a remaining one-dimensional orthogonal complement instead of asserting that the inverse square root remains defined.

不要掩盖秩亏。重复通道、常数通道，或保留维数超过中心化数据的秩，都会使白化不可能。应降到有依据的信号子空间；将所有小特征值任意截成一个常数会改变模型并可能放大噪声。单单元更新为零时无法归一化；同时更新矩阵秩亏时，也不存在唯一的可逆极分解因子。特别地，精确高斯总体成分的更新为零：应恢复可辨识的非高斯成分，再显式补全剩余的一维正交补，不能声称逆平方根在这里仍有定义。

Convergence is numerical, not scientific validation. If c=1−∣wnew⊤w∣c=1-|\bw_{\rm new}^\top\bw|c=1−∣wnew⊤​w∣, the small acute angle between the iterates is approximately 2c\sqrt{2c}2c​ radians, not ccc. A tolerance of 10−1210^{-12}10−12 corresponds to roughly 1.4×10−61.4\times10^{-6}1.4×10−6 radians. This only checks that an iterate has stopped changing. Compare multiple starts after one-to-one component matching, inspect the retained rank and the nonlinearity, and assess stability on resampled data. Keep failure rates as well as successful runs; never count an iteration limit as convergence.

数值收敛不是科学验证。若 c=1−∣wnew⊤w∣c=1-|\bw_{\rm new}^\top\bw|c=1−∣wnew⊤​w∣，两次迭代之间的小锐角约为 2c\sqrt{2c}2c​ 弧度，而不是 ccc。容差 10−1210^{-12}10−12 对应约 1.4×10−61.4\times10^{-6}1.4×10−6 弧度。它只表示迭代变化已经很小。应在成分一一匹配后比较多个初值，检查保留秩与非线性函数，并用重抽样评价稳定性。既要报告成功结果，也要报告失败率；达到迭代上限不能算作收敛。

Save the fitted transformation. The code returns both W\bWW and the training mean. Apply them unchanged to new observations; refitting the mean or whitening separately on each test block changes the transform being evaluated. Because sign and order are arbitrary, store any later sign flips and permutations with the transform. These are conventions for reporting, not additional information recovered from the observations.

保存已拟合的变换。代码同时返回 W\bWW 与训练均值，对新观测应原样使用；在每个测试块上重新拟合均值或白化会改变正在评价的变换。符号与顺序本来就是任意的，因此后续采用的符号翻转与置换也应与变换一起保存。这些是报告约定，不是从观测中额外恢复的信息。

Key points

本章要点

  • On whitened data, FastICA iterates w←E[z g(w⊤z)]−E[g′(w⊤z)] w\bw \leftarrow \E[\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)] - \E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)]\,\bww←E[zg(w⊤z)]−E[g′(w⊤z)]w followed by normalization: an approximate Newton step for the Lagrange condition, in which whiteness makes the Jacobian diagonal. There is no step size.
  • In source coordinates the kurtosis iteration is exactly qi+=κiqi3q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3qi+​=κi​qi3​: when the largest weighted initial coordinate is unique and positive, it converges cubically to the source that maximizes ∣κi∣ ∣qi(0)∣\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|∣κi​∣​∣qi(0)​∣.
  • For an odd smooth ggg satisfying the theorem, every source with λi=E[si g(si)−g′(si)]≠0\lambda_i = \E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)] \ne 0λi​=E[si​g(si​)−g′(si​)]=0 is a fixed point with at least quadratic convergence (cubic for symmetric sources). Sub- and super-Gaussian sources are found with the same ggg; Gaussian sources are never fixed points.
  • Several components are obtained by deflation, which accumulates errors along the sequence, or by symmetric orthogonalization W←(WW⊤)−1/2W\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bWW←(WW⊤)−1/2W, the closest orthogonal matrix, which treats all units alike.
  • Bounded ggg reduces sensitivity to extreme projections, but does not guarantee robustness of whitening or of the whole estimator; the accuracy for each source is governed by λi\lambda_iλi​, and the best ggg is the score of the source.
  • 在白化数据上，FastICA 迭代 w←E[z g(w⊤z)]−E[g′(w⊤z)] w\bw \leftarrow \E[\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)] - \E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)]\,\bww←E[zg(w⊤z)]−E[g′(w⊤z)]w 并归一化：这是对 Lagrange 条件的近似牛顿步，白化使雅可比矩阵成为对角阵。算法没有步长。
  • 在源坐标下，峭度迭代恰好是 qi+=κiqi3q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3qi+​=κi​qi3​：当加权初始坐标的最大绝对值唯一且为正时，它三次收敛到使 ∣κi∣ ∣qi(0)∣\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|∣κi​∣​∣qi(0)​∣ 最大的那个源。
  • 对满足定理条件的光滑奇函数 ggg，每个满足 λi=E[si g(si)−g′(si)]≠0\lambda_i = \E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)] \ne 0λi​=E[si​g(si​)−g′(si​)]=0 的源都是不动点，收敛至少是二次的（对称源时为三次）。同一个 ggg 能找到亚高斯源和超高斯源；高斯源永远不是不动点。
  • 多个成分可以用逐个提取（紧缩）得到，但误差会沿序列累积；也可以用对称正交化 W←(WW⊤)−1/2W\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bWW←(WW⊤)−1/2W 得到，它给出最近的正交矩阵，并对所有单元一视同仁。
  • 有界 ggg 可减弱极端投影的影响，但不保证白化或整个估计量都稳健；每个源的估计精度由 λi\lambda_iλi​ 决定，最优的 ggg 是该源的得分函数。

Before the exercises

开始习题前

  • Whiten first, update a direction, then normalize with a degeneracy check.
  • Compare directions up to sign and distinguish local theory from finite-sample behavior.
  • Multiple rows need a mechanism that prevents repeatedly finding one direction.
  • 先白化，再更新方向，检查退化情况后才归一化。
  • 在允许反号的意义下比较方向，并区分局部理论与有限样本行为。
  • 多行估计需要防止反复找到同一方向的机制。

Start with the cubic-update exercise, then parts (a) and (b) of the orthogonalization exercise. Next try the Gaussian-source exercise; save the Newton proof for a second pass.

先做三次更新习题，再做正交化习题的（a）（b），随后尝试高斯源习题；牛顿法证明留到第二遍。

8.8 Exercises习题

Exercise 8.1习题 8.1 basic基础

Show that for G(u)=u4/4G(u) = u^4/4G(u)=u4/4, whitened data and ∥w∥=1\|\bw\| = 1∥w∥=1, the update (8.3) becomes w+=E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w\bw^+ = \E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] - 3\bww+=E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w. What changes if the data are only centered, not whitened?

证明对 G(u)=u4/4G(u) = u^4/4G(u)=u4/4、白化数据和 ∥w∥=1\|\bw\| = 1∥w∥=1，更新 (8.3) 变为 w+=E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w\bw^+ = \E[\bz(\bw^\top\bz)^3] - 3\bww+=E[z(w⊤z)3]−3w。如果数据只中心化而没有白化，会有什么变化？

Show solution查看解答

Here g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3 and g′(u)=3u2g'(u) = 3u^2g′(u)=3u2, so E[g′(w⊤z)]=3 E[(w⊤z)2]=3 w⊤E[zz⊤] w=3∥w∥2=3\E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)] = 3\,\E[(\bw^\top\bz)^2] = 3\,\bw^\top\E[\bz\bz^\top]\,\bw = 3\|\bw\|^2 = 3E[g′(w⊤z)]=3E[(w⊤z)2]=3w⊤E[zz⊤]w=3∥w∥2=3. Without whitening, E[(w⊤x)2]=w⊤Cxw\E[(\bw^\top\bx)^2] = \bw^\top\bC_{\bx}\bwE[(w⊤x)2]=w⊤Cx​w is no longer 1 on the unit sphere, so the coefficient changes from point to point; worse, the derivation used E[zz⊤]=I\E[\bz\bz^\top] = \bIE[zz⊤]=I to make the Jacobian diagonal, and the identity qi+=κiqi3q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3qi+​=κi​qi3​ relied on A~\tilde\bAA~ being orthogonal. On unwhitened data the iteration is no longer an approximate Newton method and its fixed points need not be the source directions.

此时 g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3，g′(u)=3u2g'(u) = 3u^2g′(u)=3u2，所以 E[g′(w⊤z)]=3 E[(w⊤z)2]=3 w⊤E[zz⊤] w=3∥w∥2=3\E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)] = 3\,\E[(\bw^\top\bz)^2] = 3\,\bw^\top\E[\bz\bz^\top]\,\bw = 3\|\bw\|^2 = 3E[g′(w⊤z)]=3E[(w⊤z)2]=3w⊤E[zz⊤]w=3∥w∥2=3。若不白化，单位球面上的 E[(w⊤x)2]=w⊤Cxw\E[(\bw^\top\bx)^2] = \bw^\top\bC_{\bx}\bwE[(w⊤x)2]=w⊤Cx​w 不再等于 1，系数随点而变；更严重的是，推导中正是用 E[zz⊤]=I\E[\bz\bz^\top] = \bIE[zz⊤]=I 使雅可比矩阵成为对角阵，而恒等式 qi+=κiqi3q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3qi+​=κi​qi3​ 依赖于 A~\tilde\bAA~ 是正交矩阵。在未白化的数据上，这一迭代不再是近似牛顿法，其不动点也不一定是源方向。

Exercise 8.2习题 8.2 basic基础

Suppose source 1 is Gaussian and the others are not. (a) Using Stein's lemma (Exercise 7.4习题 7.4), show that λ1=0\lambda_1 = 0λ1​=0 for every ggg. (b) With the kurtosis nonlinearity, what happens to the coordinate q1q_1q1​ after one iteration? (c) Can the one-unit iteration converge to ±e1\pm\be_1±e1​?

设源 1 是高斯的，其余的源不是。（a）利用 Stein 引理（Exercise 7.4习题 7.4）证明：对任何 ggg 都有 λ1=0\lambda_1 = 0λ1​=0。（b）使用峭度非线性时，坐标 q1q_1q1​ 经过一次迭代后会怎样？（c）单单元迭代能否收敛到 ±e1\pm\be_1±e1​？

Show solution查看解答

(a) For s1∼N(0,1)s_1 \sim \Ncal(0, 1)s1​∼N(0,1), Stein's lemma gives E[s1g(s1)]=E[g′(s1)]\E[s_1g(s_1)] = \E[g'(s_1)]E[s1​g(s1​)]=E[g′(s1​)], so λ1=0\lambda_1 = 0λ1​=0. (b) κ1=0\kappa_1 = 0κ1​=0, so q1+=κ1q13=0q_1^+ = \kappa_1q_1^3 = 0q1+​=κ1​q13​=0: the Gaussian coordinate is removed in a single step, and the iteration continues among the non-Gaussian sources. (c) No. At q=e1\bq = \be_1q=e1​ the unnormalized update is λ1e1=0\lambda_1\be_1 = \bzeroλ1​e1​=0, so e1\be_1e1​ is not even a well-defined fixed point; for kurtosis, part (a) of Theorem 8.3定理 8.3 shows that the limit is the non-Gaussian source maximizing ∣κi∣ ∣qi(0)∣\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|∣κi​∣​∣qi(0)​∣. This is how FastICA copes with one Gaussian source: it finds the others, then explicitly completes the remaining one-dimensional orthogonal complement. At exact population separation the Gaussian row has a zero update, so the full symmetric inverse-square-root step is singular and needs special handling; finite-sample implementations may instead return a noise-determined row.

（a）对 s1∼N(0,1)s_1 \sim \Ncal(0, 1)s1​∼N(0,1)，Stein 引理给出 E[s1g(s1)]=E[g′(s1)]\E[s_1g(s_1)] = \E[g'(s_1)]E[s1​g(s1​)]=E[g′(s1​)]，所以 λ1=0\lambda_1 = 0λ1​=0。（b）κ1=0\kappa_1 = 0κ1​=0，所以 q1+=κ1q13=0q_1^+ = \kappa_1q_1^3 = 0q1+​=κ1​q13​=0：高斯坐标一步就被消去，迭代此后只在非高斯源之间进行。（c）不能。在 q=e1\bq = \be_1q=e1​ 处，未归一化的更新为 λ1e1=0\lambda_1\be_1 = \bzeroλ1​e1​=0，所以 e1\be_1e1​ 连定义良好的不动点都不是；对峭度，Theorem 8.3定理 8.3的（a）表明极限是使 ∣κi∣ ∣qi(0)∣\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|∣κi​∣​∣qi(0)​∣ 最大的那个非高斯源。FastICA 就是这样处理一个高斯源的：它先找到其余的源，随后显式补全剩余的一维正交补。在精确总体分离点，高斯行的更新为零，因此完整对称逆平方根步骤奇异，需要专门处理；有限样本实现也可能返回一个由抽样噪声决定的行。

Exercise 8.3习题 8.3 intermediate进阶

Let W=(1101)\bW = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1 & 1\\ 0 & 1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)W=(10​11​). (a) Orthonormalize its rows by Gram–Schmidt, first in the order (row 1, row 2), then in the order (row 2, row 1). (b) Compute (WW⊤)−1/2W(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW(WW⊤)−1/2W and verify that it is orthogonal. (c) Explain, using Proposition 8.5命题 8.5, why (b) is the natural choice for symmetric FastICA.

设 W=(1101)\bW = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1 & 1\\ 0 & 1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)W=(10​11​)。（a）用 Gram–Schmidt 方法把它的行标准正交化，先按（第 1 行，第 2 行）的顺序，再按（第 2 行，第 1 行）的顺序。（b）计算 (WW⊤)−1/2W(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW(WW⊤)−1/2W，并验证它是正交矩阵。（c）利用Proposition 8.5命题 8.5解释为什么（b）是对称 FastICA 的自然选择。

Show solution查看解答

(a) Order (1, 2): w1=(1,1)/2\bw_1 = (1, 1)/\sqrt2w1​=(1,1)/2​; then (0,1)−12(1,1)=(−12,12)(0, 1) - \tfrac12(1, 1) = (-\tfrac12, \tfrac12)(0,1)−21​(1,1)=(−21​,21​), normalized w2=(−1,1)/2\bw_2 = (-1, 1)/\sqrt2w2​=(−1,1)/2​. Order (2, 1): w2=(0,1)\bw_2 = (0, 1)w2​=(0,1); then (1,1)−(0,1)=(1,0)=w1(1, 1) - (0, 1) = (1, 0) = \bw_1(1,1)−(0,1)=(1,0)=w1​. The two orders give different matrices; whichever row comes first is kept in its direction. (b) WW⊤=(2111)\bW\bW^\top = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}2 & 1\\ 1 & 1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)WW⊤=(21​11​). For a 2×22 \times 22×2 matrix with positive determinant the polar factor is the rotation (cos⁡θ−sin⁡θsin⁡θcos⁡θ)\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}\cos\theta & -\sin\theta\\ \sin\theta & \cos\theta\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(cosθsinθ​−sinθcosθ​) that maximizes tr⁡(R(θ)⊤W)=(w11+w22)cos⁡θ+(w21−w12)sin⁡θ\tr(\bR(\theta)^\top\bW) = (w_{11} + w_{22})\cos\theta + (w_{21} - w_{12})\sin\thetatr(R(θ)⊤W)=(w11​+w22​)cosθ+(w21​−w12​)sinθ, so (cos⁡θ,sin⁡θ)∝(w11+w22, w21−w12)=(2,−1)(\cos\theta, \sin\theta) \propto (w_{11} + w_{22},\ w_{21} - w_{12}) = (2, -1)(cosθ,sinθ)∝(w11​+w22​, w21​−w12​)=(2,−1) and (WW⊤)−1/2W=15(21−12)(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt5}\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}2 & 1\\ -1 & 2\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(WW⊤)−1/2W=5​1​(2−1​12​), whose rows are orthonormal (a direct computation of LR⊤\mathbf{L}\bR^\topLR⊤ from the singular value decomposition gives the same matrix). The first row turns by about 18.4∘18.4^\circ18.4∘ clockwise and the second by about 26.6∘26.6^\circ26.6∘ counterclockwise: both rows move, instead of one of them staying fixed as in Gram–Schmidt. (c) The result is the orthogonal matrix closest to W\bWW, and permuting the rows of W\bWW permutes the result in the same way: no unit is privileged, so each one is corrected by the least possible amount instead of absorbing all the constraints of the units processed before it.

（a）按顺序（1，2）：w1=(1,1)/2\bw_1 = (1, 1)/\sqrt2w1​=(1,1)/2​；然后 (0,1)−12(1,1)=(−12,12)(0, 1) - \tfrac12(1, 1) = (-\tfrac12, \tfrac12)(0,1)−21​(1,1)=(−21​,21​)，归一化得 w2=(−1,1)/2\bw_2 = (-1, 1)/\sqrt2w2​=(−1,1)/2​。按顺序（2，1）：w2=(0,1)\bw_2 = (0, 1)w2​=(0,1)；然后 (1,1)−(0,1)=(1,0)=w1(1, 1) - (0, 1) = (1, 0) = \bw_1(1,1)−(0,1)=(1,0)=w1​。两种顺序给出不同的矩阵；哪一行排在前面，哪一行的方向就保持不变。（b）WW⊤=(2111)\bW\bW^\top = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}2 & 1\\ 1 & 1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)WW⊤=(21​11​)。对行列式为正的 2×22 \times 22×2 矩阵，极分解因子是使 tr⁡(R(θ)⊤W)=(w11+w22)cos⁡θ+(w21−w12)sin⁡θ\tr(\bR(\theta)^\top\bW) = (w_{11} + w_{22})\cos\theta + (w_{21} - w_{12})\sin\thetatr(R(θ)⊤W)=(w11​+w22​)cosθ+(w21​−w12​)sinθ 最大的旋转 (cos⁡θ−sin⁡θsin⁡θcos⁡θ)\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}\cos\theta & -\sin\theta\\ \sin\theta & \cos\theta\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(cosθsinθ​−sinθcosθ​)，所以 (cos⁡θ,sin⁡θ)∝(w11+w22, w21−w12)=(2,−1)(\cos\theta, \sin\theta) \propto (w_{11} + w_{22},\ w_{21} - w_{12}) = (2, -1)(cosθ,sinθ)∝(w11​+w22​, w21​−w12​)=(2,−1)，于是 (WW⊤)−1/2W=15(21−12)(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt5}\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}2 & 1\\ -1 & 2\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(WW⊤)−1/2W=5​1​(2−1​12​)，其各行标准正交（由奇异值分解直接计算 LR⊤\mathbf{L}\bR^\topLR⊤ 得到同一矩阵）。第一行顺时针转过约 18.4∘18.4^\circ18.4∘，第二行逆时针转过约 26.6∘26.6^\circ26.6∘：两行都移动了，而不像 Gram–Schmidt 那样有一行保持不动。（c）这个结果是离 W\bWW 最近的正交矩阵，并且置换 W\bWW 的行时结果以同样方式置换：没有哪个单元享有特权，每个单元都只被修正尽可能少的量，而不是承担所有排在它前面的单元带来的约束。

(a) The (j,k)(j, k)(j,k) entry is E[sjsk g′(si)]\E[s_js_k\,g'(s_i)]E[sj​sk​g′(si​)]. This is the stated matrix: E[g′(si)]\E[g'(s_i)]E[g′(si​)] on the diagonal except in position (i,i)(i, i)(i,i). On vectors orthogonal to ei\be_iei​ it acts as E[g′(si)]I\E[g'(s_i)]\bIE[g′(si​)]I, and E[g′(q⊤s)]=E[g′(si)]\E[g'(\bq^\top\bs)] = \E[g'(s_i)]E[g′(q⊤s)]=E[g′(si​)] at q=ei\bq = \be_iq=ei​, so the approximation is exact there. (b) The unnormalized update is u(q)=E[s g(q⊤s)]−E[g′(q⊤s)] q\bu(\bq) = \E[\bs\,g(\bq^\top\bs)] - \E[g'(\bq^\top\bs)]\,\bqu(q)=E[sg(q⊤s)]−E[g′(q⊤s)]q. Its derivative at ei\be_iei​ in a direction δ⊥ei\boldsymbol{\delta} \perp \be_iδ⊥ei​ is E[ss⊤g′(si)] δ−E[g′(si)] δ−(E[s⊤g′′(si)]δ) ei\E[\bs\bs^\top g'(s_i)]\,\boldsymbol{\delta} - \E[g'(s_i)]\,\boldsymbol{\delta} - (\E[\bs^\top g''(s_i)]\boldsymbol{\delta})\,\be_iE[ss⊤g′(si​)]δ−E[g′(si​)]δ−(E[s⊤g′′(si​)]δ)ei​. By (a) the first two terms cancel, and the last is parallel to ei\be_iei​ (in fact zero, since E[skg′′(si)]=0\E[s_kg''(s_i)] = 0E[sk​g′′(si​)]=0 for k≠ik \ne ik=i). So the tangent components of u(ei+δ)\bu(\be_i + \boldsymbol{\delta})u(ei​+δ) are o(∥δ∥)o(\|\boldsymbol{\delta}\|)o(∥δ∥), while the radial component tends to λi≠0\lambda_i \ne 0λi​=0. After normalization the new tangential error is o(∥δ∥)o(\|\boldsymbol{\delta}\|)o(∥δ∥): the map has zero derivative at its fixed point, which implies superlinear convergence; the second-order term computed in Theorem 8.3定理 8.3 makes it at least quadratic. In Newton terms, the method uses the exact Jacobian on exactly the directions that matter.

（a）矩阵的 (j,k)(j, k)(j,k) 元为 E[sjsk g′(si)]\E[s_js_k\,g'(s_i)]E[sj​sk​g′(si​)]。若 j≠kj \ne kj=k，至少有一个下标不等于 iii 且只出现一次，由独立性和零均值得 0（若 j=i≠kj = i \ne kj=i=k：E[sig′(si)]E[sk]=0\E[s_ig'(s_i)]\E[s_k] = 0E[si​g′(si​)]E[sk​]=0）。若 j=k≠ij = k \ne ij=k=i：E[sj2]E[g′(si)]=E[g′(si)]\E[s_j^2]\E[g'(s_i)] = \E[g'(s_i)]E[sj2​]E[g′(si​)]=E[g′(si​)]。若 j=k=ij = k = ij=k=i：E[si2g′(si)]\E[s_i^2g'(s_i)]E[si2​g′(si​)]。这正是所给的矩阵：除 (i,i)(i, i)(i,i) 位置外，对角元都是 E[g′(si)]\E[g'(s_i)]E[g′(si​)]。它作用在与 ei\be_iei​ 正交的向量上就等于 E[g′(si)]I\E[g'(s_i)]\bIE[g′(si​)]I，而在 q=ei\bq = \be_iq=ei​ 处 E[g′(q⊤s)]=E[g′(si)]\E[g'(\bq^\top\bs)] = \E[g'(s_i)]E[g′(q⊤s)]=E[g′(si​)]，所以那里的近似是精确的。（b）未归一化的更新为 u(q)=E[s g(q⊤s)]−E[g′(q⊤s)] q\bu(\bq) = \E[\bs\,g(\bq^\top\bs)] - \E[g'(\bq^\top\bs)]\,\bqu(q)=E[sg(q⊤s)]−E[g′(q⊤s)]q。它在 ei\be_iei​ 处沿方向 δ⊥ei\boldsymbol{\delta} \perp \be_iδ⊥ei​ 的导数为 E[ss⊤g′(si)] δ−E[g′(si)] δ−(E[s⊤g′′(si)]δ) ei\E[\bs\bs^\top g'(s_i)]\,\boldsymbol{\delta} - \E[g'(s_i)]\,\boldsymbol{\delta} - (\E[\bs^\top g''(s_i)]\boldsymbol{\delta})\,\be_iE[ss⊤g′(si​)]δ−E[g′(si​)]δ−(E[s⊤g′′(si​)]δ)ei​。由（a），前两项相互抵消，最后一项平行于 ei\be_iei​（实际上为零，因为对 k≠ik \ne ik=i 有 E[skg′′(si)]=0\E[s_kg''(s_i)] = 0E[sk​g′′(si​)]=0）。所以 u(ei+δ)\bu(\be_i + \boldsymbol{\delta})u(ei​+δ) 的切向分量是 o(∥δ∥)o(\|\boldsymbol{\delta}\|)o(∥δ∥)，而径向分量趋于 λi≠0\lambda_i \ne 0λi​=0。归一化后，新的切向误差是 o(∥δ∥)o(\|\boldsymbol{\delta}\|)o(∥δ∥)：映射在其不动点处导数为零，由此收敛是超线性的；Theorem 8.3定理 8.3中算出的二阶项则说明它至少是二次的。用牛顿法的语言说，该方法恰好在要紧的那些方向上使用了精确的雅可比矩阵。
